receiver.message_back: Subject to Seller approval and agreement on the price, we propose a fixed purchase price denominated in USD, payable in full by wire transfer of immediately available funds at closing, without escrow, holdback, adjustment or set-off; the financial-statement representation should cover only specifically identified statements and their stated accounting basis, qualified by materiality and disclosures. Indemnity should be the Buyer’s exclusive contractual remedy, limited to breaches of express representations, excluding disclosed liabilities, capped at 10% of the purchase price with a 1% deductible basket and 12-month survival, subject to timely, reasonably detailed written claims and customary mitigation and no-double-recovery provisions, with an exception for Seller’s actual fraud.

drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. Attached is our counterdraft, subject to client approval and agreement on the purchase price. We have reflected USD payment by wire at closing, with the proposed absence of escrow, adjustments and set-off expressly reserved for confirmation. Please identify the financial statements and their accounting basis. We cannot accept limiting indemnity solely to express representations or making it the exclusive contractual remedy on the present record; the draft retains coverage for undisclosed liabilities and covenant breaches. The proposed cap, basket and survival period remain open, and we have included claims, mitigation, no-double-recovery and actual-fraud provisions for discussion.

edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. The purchase price for the Shares shall be USD [amount to be agreed] (the “Purchase Price”), payable by the Buyer to the Seller at Closing by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by the Seller in writing. [Subject to express agreement by both parties: the Purchase Price shall be fixed and payable in full without escrow, holdback, adjustment or set-off.]
Please confirm the amount. The bracketed allocation of payment risk remains open and is not an agreed term.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents to the Buyer, as of signing and Closing, that the financial statements specifically identified in Schedule 3, including their dates and reporting periods (the “Financial Statements”), have been prepared in accordance with the accounting basis specified for them in Schedule 3, consistently applied except as expressly stated therein, and fairly present in all material respects the financial position and results of operations they purport to present on that basis, except as fairly disclosed with sufficient detail to identify the nature and scope of the exception in the corresponding section of the disclosure schedule delivered to and agreed by the Buyer at signing.

Please supply Schedule 3 identifying each covered statement, its date, reporting period and accounting basis, together with proposed specific disclosure exceptions. Scope remains subject to review of those materials.

4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer against losses arising from (a) breaches of the Seller’s express representations under this Agreement, (b) breaches of the Seller’s covenants under this Agreement, and (c) liabilities of the company whose Shares are being acquired arising from events or circumstances occurring on or before Closing, except liabilities fairly disclosed with sufficient detail to identify their nature and scope in the disclosure schedule delivered to and agreed by the Buyer at signing. Any monetary cap, deductible basket and survival period, and the claims to which each applies, remain [to be agreed]. The Buyer shall give written notice of a claim within the applicable agreed survival period, describing in reasonable detail the basis of the claim and, to the extent then reasonably ascertainable, the estimated loss. A timely notified claim shall survive until finally resolved; failure to state an amount not then reasonably ascertainable shall not invalidate notice. The Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate recoverable losses and shall not recover more than once for the same loss. Indemnification shall not be the Buyer’s exclusive contractual remedy, subject to the prohibition on double recovery. Nothing in this Section shall limit liability or remedies for the Seller’s actual fraud.

Counterproposal retains undisclosed-liability and covenant coverage. Seller’s proposed 10% cap, 1% deductible basket, 12-month survival and exclusive-remedy structure are not accepted. Please address the scope of any limitations and appropriate exceptions. Third-party claim defense and settlement procedures also remain to be agreed.

receiver.message_back: Subject to client approval and agreement on price, we propose full USD payment by wire at Closing without escrow, holdback, adjustment or set-off, and indemnity for breaches of express representations and covenants—not a standalone guarantee of all undisclosed liabilities—as the exclusive monetary remedy, subject to an aggregate 10% cap, a 1% deductible basket and 12-month survival, with timely notified claims preserved and actual fraud excluded from those limitations. We will seek client confirmation of the Schedule 3 statements, accounting basis and specific disclosures, and can accept reasonable mitigation and no-double-recovery provisions plus Seller-controlled third-party defense procedures prohibiting settlements imposing admissions or nonmonetary obligations on the Buyer without its consent.
